items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I had met Ross, but Ross wasn't in no position to do anything.

ctx.x: Now, had you met Ross Russell by this time?
Yeah, I had met Ross, but Ross wasn't in no position to do anything. He only had a little store, you know.
He wasn't really into Dial yet.
